sharedMapEvidence: Not applicable — no protocol found on any model. Grouped as one line because they are one licensee's product family, which is explicitly NOT dialect evidence; here it costs nothing because there is no dialect.
gotchas: Different licensee from Energizer Solar. energizergenerators.com / energizerarc.com is a separate North American brand licensee with its own model numbering (EN0193 style). Its Arc line and Energizer Solar's Peak/Everest line are unrelated hardware that both say 'Energizer' on the case.
Arc 1200 Pro is 1075 Wh / 1200 W pure sine, LiFePO4, 12 ports including 100 W USB-C and wireless charging. No data port, Bluetooth, or app is listed on the product page.
Confidence is unverified because the only source is a retailer/vendor product page, not a manual. Absence of a mention is weaker than a manual with no connectivity chapter. checked: 2026-07-31.
This is the line actually sold through Canadian big-box (Home Depot Canada, KMS Tools) and therefore the one most likely to be behind the 'battery' tag on the Quebec brand wall.
